text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf seems to be the name<n>on
everybody's lips, but she only<n>comes second in
the fan poll.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Resolving to deliver a performance<n>that will
convince the holdouts of her<n>strength, the two of
us leave the<n>waiting room to face the Arima Kinen.
